title: A Modern Pack
description: This modpack is a mix of technology, cars, airplanes, and basically everything in the modern world.
body:
Hello! This is my first modpack that I've uploaded.

This is a Modern Pack. 

It is an attempt at making _**almost**_ replica of real life.

Thing are subject to change.

The modpack adds the following: Hydration, working cars, working laptops, create mods, and more.

There might be a Forge version coming out as well. (hint, its too big to upload, its _**~~4GB~~**_.)
